expectations.text: Output does not force an artificial steelman/critique structure onto what is fundamentally a recommendation request
expectations.evidence: Follows the skill's template almost exactly: opening validation ('Nghe hợp lý ở chỗ...'), 3 numbered unverified-assumption points, 'Góc nhìn khác', 'Rủi ro nếu bỏ qua', closing question — applied to a plan-recommendation question, not a stance to critique.

expectations.text: Output addresses the actual question (5x vs 20x plan choice, and whether current usage would max out those limits) rather than producing an unrelated critique
expectations.evidence: Content stays on-topic (usage pattern, model mix, monitoring, pay-as-you-go alternative) even though framed as critique.

expectations.text: Output either answers helpfully or asks a clarifying question about missing info instead of fabricating a critique-shaped response
expectations.evidence: Never gives a working recommendation or even a conditional one ('if X then 5x, if Y then 20x') the way the baseline does — ends by asking the user more questions instead of answering, wrapped throughout in critique framing ('rủi ro nếu bỏ qua bước kiểm tra này').
